tools.name: lrrk_check_updates
tools.description: Get exact record additions, corrections, and withdrawals between saved published version keys and the current public versions. Corrections identify verified changes to public fields where historical detail exists. Withdrawals link to a persistent public notice for the comparison. Follow nextPage wit

tools.name: lrrk_find_evidence
tools.description: Search published LrrK Letters, reviewed Hardware Attack Library records, and admitted Intelligence Product metadata. Returns bounded excerpts and canonical source links. Historical paid publication bodies are never returned.

tools.name: lrrk_get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the metadata, edition, citations, evidence status and limits for one public LrrK record. Request a Letter footnote by its printed number, or pass nextCitationPage as citationPage with the same kind and id. Use the returned revision to pin a later lookup. Historical Intelligence Products exp
labels.description: Map a topic and optional device class to reviewed public references and explicit gaps. Search matches are not device-specific applicability, testing, or risk verdicts.

labels.name: lrrk_find_service
labels.description: Find LrrK's human-reviewed Assess, Engage, Monitor, or one-question Evidence Brief path for a stated need. Returns criteria and a first-party link; no inquiry is submitted and no work is initiated.
